alerts.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued November 4 at 4:34AM PST until November 4 at 10:00AM PST by NWS Hanford CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Visibility one quarter mile or less in dense fog.

* WHERE...Portions of the San Joaquin Valley.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM PST this morning.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make driving conditions hazardous.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Highways impacted include State Routes 33, 41,
43, 99, 140, 145, 152, 168, 180 and 198.
alerts.instruction:
If driving, slow down, use your headlights, and leave plenty of
distance ahead of you.
